papers.title_en: Can World and Action Modeling Benefit Each Other under Unified Causal Training?
papers.authors: Yue Su, Bokai Lin, Xinkai Wang, Chubin Zhang, Xiangnan Wu, Kuan Zhang, Weiyang Jin, Jiwen Yu, Yiming Li, Cewu Lu, Lixin Yang, Xihui Liu
papers.evidence: 面向具身预测与策略学习的世界模型与动作建模统一训练
papers.tldr: 世界建模与动作生成关系密切，但统一因果训练下能否互惠仍不清楚。论文提出OneWM，将动作同时作为世界预测条件和策略学习目标，在共享视频-动作架构中统一训练。在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboCasa365及真实实验中，学习指定动作的视觉后果提升策略性能与跨场景泛化，动作学习也提升多视图世界预测保真度。结果正面回答两个问题，表明二者可相互促进。
papers.abstract_en: World and action modeling are closely related, yet their reciprocal benefits under unified causal training remain unclear. We introduce OneWM, a simple framework for unified causal training that treats actions as both conditions for world prediction and targets for policy learning within a shared video-action architecture. Using this framework, we investigate whether learning forward dynamics conditioned on specified actions improves action learning, and whether learning to generate actions in turn improves action-conditioned world modeling. We use LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboCasa365 as embodied testbeds to evaluate both policy learning and world modeling, complemented by real-world policy experiments. Learning the visual consequences of specified actions improves policy performance and generalization across changing scenes. In turn, action learning improves multi-view world-prediction fidelity under the same architecture. Together, these results answer both questions positively, supporting reciprocal benefits between world modeling and action generation under unified causal training.

papers.title_en: AnyGoal: On World Model Generalization Beyond Expert Rollouts
papers.authors: Heejeong Nam, Divyat Mahajan, Quentin Le Lidec, Randall Balestriero, David Klindt
papers.evidence: 面向智能体规划的世界模型泛化
papers.tldr: 世界模型要可靠地用于规划，就必须在专家轨迹之外的状态-动作组合上仍能正确预测动力学，但数据覆盖、动力学泛化与下游规划性能之间的关系尚不清楚。作者从组合泛化角度出发，提出 AnyGoal 基准和开源库：它基于常用世界模型环境构造目标偏移任务，让各状态因子与动作都落在训练支撑内，只是它们的组合在专家轨迹中较少出现。在多个环境和世界模型家族上的实验显示，现有模型在这类重组情形下会稳定失败。该工作为评估面向新规划任务的泛化世界模型提供了统一框架与分析基础。
papers.abstract_en: The goal of a world model is to capture the dynamics of an environment. This has the great appeal that it allows agents to plan and simulate a course of actions with the help of a world model. For these uses to be reliable, however, the learned dynamics must behave well beyond the specific state-action combinations observed in expert rollouts. Despite this, the relationship between data coverage, dynamics generalization, and downstream planning performance remains underexplored. We study this relationship through the lens of compositional generalization: can a world model recombine familiar state and action factors into valid dynamics? To answer this, we introduce AnyGoal, a benchmark of goal-shifted task variants built from widely used world-model environments, together with an open-source library. Each task is designed to be within reach of a world model that has learned the underlying dynamics: individual state factors and actions remain within their training support, but their combinations are underrepresented in expert trajectories. Across multiple environments and world model families, we find that current models consistently exhibit failures under these recombinations. By examining dynamics and representation failures across model families, interaction regimes, and evaluation metrics, we study where current world models generalize and where challenges remain for goal-shifted prediction and planning. Together, this framework, benchmark, and analysis provide a basis for evaluating progress toward world models that generalize to new planning tasks.

papers.title_en: Large Multimodal Models for Direct Robot Control: GPT-6 as a Beginning
papers.authors: Youwei Zhou, Bohan Hou, Yankai Fu, Yaoxu Lyu, Yifan Ye, Shilin Shan, Chen Guo, Jiaming Liu, Ran He, Caifeng Shan, Shanghang Zhang, Jianfei Yang, Zhihe Lu
papers.evidence: 多模态模型闭环机器人操作，考察深度、上下文学习与触觉
papers.tldr: 通用多模态模型能否直接控制机器人仍缺乏系统认识。本文用轻量智能体框架系统评测GPT-6 Astra的闭环操作能力，先考察深度感知、具身上下文学习与触觉理解三项基础能力，再在五个操作基准的六个维度上评测，并提出几何约束新基准LIBERO-GeoMotion。结果显示语义推理与物理执行之间存在明显鸿沟，零样本精度与运动可行性不足、推理延迟高，为通用模型走向可靠机器人操作划定了关键挑战。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in visuospatial understanding and agentic reasoning enable direct robotic manipulation with general-purpose multimodal models, but their embodied capabilities remain poorly understood. This paper systematically evaluate GPT-6 Astra for closed-loop robotic manipulation using a lightweight agent execution framework. We first probe three fundamental embodied capabilities-depth perception, embodied in-context learning, and tactile understanding-and demonstrate that the model can exploit depth information, acquire simple manipulation strategies from contextual demonstrations, and use tactile feedback to correct its actions. We then evaluate GPT-6 Astra across five established manipulation benchmarks along six capability dimensions. Despite competitive performance on several benchmarks-26.92\% success on RoboDojo and 76.0\% on RoboTwin 2.0-our analysis reveals a pronounced gap between semantic reasoning and physical execution, particularly in consequence-aware action planning, precision, and complex motion coordination. To further examine these limitations, we introduce LIBERO-GeoMotion, a new benchmark of geometry-constrained tasks that require precise pose alignment, coordinated translation and rotation, and anticipation of physical action consequences. GPT-6 Astra achieves only 11.1\% zero-shot success, exposing the difficulty of translating spatial understanding into physically feasible motion. Real-world experiments corroborate these findings: zero-shot execution is feasible for simple tasks, yet persistent deficits remain in motion feasibility, precise control, and physical safety, while substantial inference latency further hinders practical deployment. Overall, our results characterize the emerging embodied capabilities of general-purpose multimodal models and delineate the key challenges toward safe, efficient, and reliable robotic manipulation.

papers.title_en: Near-Optimal Consistency-Robustness Bounds for Non-Clairvoyant Scheduling
papers.authors: Sizhe Li, Nicolas Christianson, Tongxin Li
papers.evidence: 带预测处理时间的作业调度一致性与鲁棒性界
papers.tldr: 论文研究带预测处理时间的单机非透视调度中一致性与鲁棒性的最优权衡。作者用多阶段对抗构造给出新的下界，并设计匹配算法，使任意 n 下上下界相差不超过 3/2。结果显示，任何 (1+λ)-一致算法在 n→∞ 时鲁棒性至少为 1/√λ，而算法在任意 n 下至多达到 1/2+√(5/4+1/λ)，主导项匹配。该工作还给出误差容忍版本，并闭合最坏 n 情形的多项式差距。
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of characterizing the optimal consistency--robustness tradeoff for single-machine non-clairvoyant scheduling with predicted processing times. For a fixed number of jobs $n$, Wei and Zhang (2020) established a lower bound on the achievable consistency--robustness tradeoff which is known to be tight only in a few restrictive cases, leaving the optimal tradeoff for general $n$ unresolved. A different worst-case-$n$ regime was introduced by Benomar et al. (2025), who applied the former work's construction to show that for $λ\in (0, 1)$, any $(1+λ)$-consistent algorithm must be $1 + Ω(\sqrt{1/λ})$-robust. On the other hand, the best known upper bound gives $(1+λ)$-consistency and $1+O(1/λ)$-robustness, leaving a polynomial gap. In this work, we develop a new lower bound using a multi-stage adversarial construction and a new algorithm that together give a near-optimal characterization of the consistency--robustness tradeoff: for every $n$, our upper bound is within a multiplicative factor $3/2$ of our lower bound, and thus our algorithm is within a multiplicative factor $3/2$ of the online optimal. In particular, our lower bound shows that any $(1+λ)$-consistent algorithm must have robustness at least $1/\sqrtλ$ as $n \to \infty$, while our algorithm achieves robustness at most $\frac{1}{2}+\sqrt{\frac{5}{4}+1/λ}$ for any $n$, matching the lower bound in the leading term as $λ\downarrow 0$; our upper bound also closes the polynomial gap in the worst-case-$n$ regime. We additionally show how our algorithm can be made error-tolerant, preserving the near-optimal consistency-robustness tradeoff while incurring only slightly degraded performance under bounded prediction errors.

papers.title_en: Hard and Soft Real-Time DNN Inference Scheduling on Heterogeneous Multi-Accelerator Systems via Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Francesco Giulio Blanco, Enrico Russo, Giuseppe Ascia, Davide Patti, Maurizio Palesi
papers.evidence: 面向异构加速器硬软实时DNN推理的强化学习调度器
papers.tldr: 面向异构多加速器上混合硬/软实时DNN推理调度，现有方法难以兼顾硬实时截止期与软实时QoS。本文提出在线强化学习调度器联合选择子作业优先级与加速器分配，并叠加确定性运行时安全层进行认证。其基于机器切分的可调度性保持前缀替换准则，无需完全完成时间占优即可保证可行续接。实验表明框架在保持硬实时可调度性的同时提升QoS截止期满足率、客户端服务质量和加速器利用率。
papers.abstract_en: We present a scheduling framework for heterogeneous multi-accelerator systems executing both hard real-time and soft real-time QoS-aware DNN inference workloads. The framework combines an online reinforcement learning (RL) scheduler with a deterministic runtime safety layer. The RL scheduler dynamically generates candidate schedules by jointly selecting sub-job priorities and accelerator assignments, while runtime certification guarantees that all HRT deadlines remain satisfied independently of the learned policy.   To enable runtime certification in heterogeneous precedence-constrained systems, we introduce a schedulability-preserving prefix replacement criterion based on machine-wise cuts. The proposed criterion guarantees that runtime-generated schedule prefixes preserve the existence of a feasible continuation without requiring complete finish-time dominance with respect to a feasible reference schedule.   Experimental results on heterogeneous DNN accelerator platforms show that the proposed framework preserves HRT schedulability while improving QoS-aware deadline satisfaction, client-level service quality, and accelerator utilization compared to state-of-the-art scheduling approaches.

papers.title_en: An Introduction to World Models for Generalist Agents
papers.evidence: 支撑智能体预测与交互的世界模型
papers.tldr: 世界模型被视为通向通用智能体的重要方向，但其定义宽泛，涵盖预测动力学、学习模拟器及联合生成观测与动作等路径。本文从POMDP出发，将世界建模与控制、动力系统、信号处理和强化学习联系起来，梳理不同建模方法所捕获的知识、学习目标与决策支持方式。文章进一步讨论世界建模与策略学习的关系，指出二者可通过条件预测统一，无需分离模型。该文不追求穷尽综述，而提供统一、易读的概念框架与原理连接。
papers.abstract_en: World models have recently emerged as a promising direction toward developing generalist agents capable of understanding, predicting, and interacting with diverse environments. However, despite growing interest, the concept of a world model remains loosely defined, encompassing approaches ranging from predictive dynamics models and learned simulators to models that jointly generate future observations and actions. This introductory paper aims to clarify the concept of world models and provide a unified perspective on their role in developing generalist agents. Starting from the partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP) framework, we connect world modeling to classical control, dynamical systems, signal processing, and reinforcement learning. We introduce different approaches to world modeling, emphasizing the knowledge they capture, their learning objectives, and how they support decision-making. We further explore the relationship between world modeling and policy learning, highlighting how these capabilities can be unified through conditional prediction without requiring separate models. Rather than offering an exhaustive survey of existing methods, this paper focuses on fundamental concepts, modeling principles, and connections, with the goal of providing an accessible and unified introduction to world models for generalist agents.

papers.title_en: BOLT: Multi-Bottleneck Bound-Guided Learning for Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling with Time Lags and Resource-Coupled Transport
papers.authors: Ziheng Zhang, Wei Zhang, Yunyi Zhao, Zuming Liu, Wei Zhou, Boon Ping Gan
papers.evidence: 带车队运输耦合的柔性作业车间调度与界引导学习
papers.tldr: 柔性作业车间中车辆稀缺会让运输等待与调度相互耦合。BOLT 利用链、机器容量与车队容量松弛构造下界，并把每步下界增量作为奖励引导策略学习。在预制建筑等实例上，显式运输耦合在重载占比高时稳定优于惩罚策略；80模块三车批次平均完工时间比最佳调度规则对低13.0%，比一小时CP求解器低4.2%。该方法还能认证次优间隙，并实现毫秒级决策与秒级重规划。
papers.abstract_en: Flexible job-shop scheduling becomes resource-coupled when a scarce vehicle fleet moves jobs between stations, because the schedule sets the transport waits. BOLT (bound-oriented learning for transport-coupled scheduling) builds a lower bound from chain, machine-capacity, and fleet-capacity relaxations. The bound equals the makespan at termination, so its per-step changes form a reward that sums to a constant minus the makespan. Because it never exceeds the attainable makespan, each candidate's bound increase is a proven rise of the makespan floor, which the policy reads as a price. The root bound certifies a completed schedule's suboptimality gap without a solver. On industry-motivated 10-module prefabricated-construction instances, explicit transport coupling outperforms a transport-penalty policy in every tested cell where loaded moves occupy at least 66% of fleet time and in none at or below 56%. Across five zero-shot 50- and 80-module production batches, BOLT outperforms the best dispatching-rule pair on four and the penalty policy on the three with long moves. In the three-vehicle 80-module batch, its mean makespan is 13.0% below the best pair and 4.2% below an hour-budget constraint-programming solver whose proven gap averages 34%. BOLT decides in 2.3-5.9 ms per event on one processor core and re-plans a disruption in seconds.

papers.title_en: Communication-Free Distributed Multi-Robot Task Allocation under Partial Observations Using Labeled Multi-Bernoulli Filtering
papers.evidence: 仅依赖局部观测的无通信分布式多机器人任务分配
papers.tldr: 多机器人任务分配通常依赖机器人间通信，在部分观测、测量杂波和观测不确定性下容易受限。本文提出一种仅基于局部观测的无通信分布式任务分配框架：每台机器人利用Labeled Multi-Bernoulli（LMB）滤波器估计邻居位置，并通过贪心拍卖策略独立分配“到达目标位置”任务。执行过程中机器人持续更新状态估计并重新分配任务，从而在无显式通信条件下实现去中心化协调。蒙特卡洛仿真验证了该方法能有效完成协作任务分配，并对测量杂波和观测不确定性保持鲁棒。
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a communication-free multi-robot task allocation framework based solely on local observations. In this study, tasks are defined as reaching target locations. Each robot estimates the positions of neighboring robots using a Labeled Multi-Bernoulli (LMB) filter and independently assigns tasks through a greedy auction-based strategy. By continuously updating state estimates and reallocating tasks during execution, the proposed method enables decentralized coordination without explicit communication. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate that the proposed method enables effective cooperative task allocation without inter-robot communication while remaining robust to measurement clutter and observation uncertainty.

papers.title_en: Aging-Aware Online Distributed Scheduling for Lifecycle Carbon Reduction in Geo-Distributed Data Centers
papers.authors: Junyu Lin, Wenjie Liu, Shunbo Lei, Wentian Lu, Jianhui Wang, Junhong Liu
papers.evidence: 地理分布式数据中心的在线分布式调度与资源分配
papers.tldr: 地理分布式数据中心碳感知调度多只关注运行碳排放，忽略负载热应力引发的硬件老化与隐含碳。论文构建覆盖运行与老化碳的生命周期模型，将负载调度与利用率相关指数老化模型耦合。为在线隐私保护求解，提出TVQS增强Lyapunov框架处理不确定性，并用ZSP-ADMM实现跨数据中心分布式协调。仿真显示碳排放最多降13.0%、运营成本降12.6%。
papers.abstract_en: The rapid proliferation of data centers (DCs), driven by cloud computing and artificial intelligence (AI), has led to massive energy demand and carbon emissions, posing significant sustainability challenges. Carbon-aware optimization in geographically distributed data centers has been widely studied. Most existing approaches mainly focus on operational carbon emissions from server usage. However, existing literature often ignores workload-induced thermal stress, which accelerates nonlinear hardware degradation. This leads to more frequent server replacements and ultimately increases embodied carbon emissions. To address these limitations, we propose a comprehensive carbon life-cycle modeling framework for distributed data centers. Apart from operational carbon emissions, this work combines workload scheduling with a utilization-dependent exponential aging model to evaluate long-term carbon costs from server degradation. In order to solve the proposed optimization model in an online and privacy-preserving manner, an enhanced Lyapunov framework with time-varying queue shifting (TVQS) is first introduced to handle system uncertainties. Then, a zero-sum perturbation-based alternating direction method of multipliers (ZSP-ADMM) framework is developed to enable distributed coordination across geographically separated data centers while protecting locally exchanged workload information. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves up to 13.0% lower carbon emissions and 12.6% lower operational costs compared with benchmarks.

papers.title_en: Robust Non-Clairvoyant Scheduling with Classification Models
papers.authors: Anthony Dugois, Vincent Fagnon, Giorgio Lucarelli
papers.evidence: 结合分类模型的学习增强非先知调度
papers.tldr: 非先知单机调度中作业处理时间未知，最小化完成时间和不存在常数竞争算法。本文利用分类模型混淆矩阵，将不确定性刻画为各预测类内排列集合，并同时考察Min-Max、Min-Max Regret与期望目标。作者给出对三项准则均 oblivious 的最优非自适应策略，并证明在混淆矩阵具特定结构时自适应与随机算法可更优。该框架用分类结构替代离散场景鲁棒优化，缓解计算困难。
papers.abstract_en: We study the classical single-machine scheduling problem of minimizing the sum of completion times of jobs in a non-clairvoyant setting, where the processing time of each job remains unknown until its completion. This is a hard problem for which no constant competitive algorithm is possible. Inspired by robust optimization and learning-augmented algorithms, we introduce a novel robustness framework that leverages structural information provided by a classification model to overcome this limitation. Specifically, we assume that jobs are partitioned into classes and we have access to the confusion matrix of the classifier, whose entry $(k,\ell)$ indicates the number of jobs predicted to belong to class~$k$ but that actually belong to class~$\ell$. In this manner, we are able to characterize uncertainty as a set of permutations within each predicted class, rather than as a collection of discrete numerical scenarios, avoiding the computational difficulty of classical robust metrics, such as Min-Max and Min-Max Regret. In addition to these worst-case metrics, we also consider the expected objective over all scenarios. We first propose an optimal non-adaptive strategy that is oblivious with respect to all three robust criteria. We then investigate adaptive and randomized algorithms, showing that they can outperform the optimal non-adaptive strategy when the matrix exhibits particular structural properties.

papers.title_en: TRACE: Tackling Real-World Resource Assignment Problems via Agentic Heuristic Design
papers.authors: Jose A. Ayala-Romero, Andres Garcia-Saavedra, Xavier Costa-Perez
papers.evidence: 面向动态资源分配与调度的LLM智能体自动启发式设计
papers.tldr: 动态资源分配仍依赖人工规则，现有基于LLM的自动启发式设计只利用标量适应度，难以解释系统行为。TRACE将进化式AHD循环与智能体知识抽取流程结合，由Reasoner分析日志模式并提出假设，Coder编写执行代码验证并生成洞见或工具。在合成云基准和基于工业测量的5G vRAN场景中，TRACE持续优于先进AHD方法，开销低于2%。它为真实系统提供更可审计的调度启发式，并打通日志到启发式改进的闭环。
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic resource assignment, the real-time allocation of task streams to heterogeneous processing nodes, is the backbone of modern computing infrastructure. While learning-based schedulers excel in research, industrial deployments still rely on hand-written rules that operators can read, audit, and execute within tight latency budgets. LLM-based Automatic Heuristic Design (AHD) promises to automate writing such rules. However, existing AHD frameworks were developed for combinatorial problems fully specified to the LLM, and they learn only from a scalar fitness score. In real systems, the behaviour that determines a good heuristic, such as processor speeds or power consumption, is unknown a priori: the score reveals which heuristic performs better, but not why. This missing information is recorded in the system logs that every evaluation produces. Exploiting it is non-trivial: logs are massive and noisy, the relevant signals depend on the objective, and their content and format vary across hardware and software stacks, so they can neither be fed to an LLM as is nor processed by a fixed parser. We propose TRACE, which couples an evolutionary AHD loop with an agentic knowledge-extraction workflow. A Reasoner agent analyzes the log schema in light of the objective and formulates hypotheses about the system dynamics; a Coder agent writes and executes schema-specific code to test them, producing insights or executable tools for the evolved heuristics. We evaluate TRACE on a synthetic cloud benchmark and a 5G vRAN scenario built from industrial testbed measurements and operational traffic traces. TRACE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art AHD methods in resource assignment problems and yields more auditable heuristics at under 2% overhead.

papers.title_en: Dynamic Load Balancing under Restricting Updates
papers.authors: Aaron Bernstein, Sayan Bhattacharya, Peter Kiss, Thatchaphol Saranurak
papers.evidence: 动态负载均衡中将作业分配到机器以最小化最大负载
papers.tldr: 动态负载均衡需在作业与机器二部图上持续分配带权作业，以最小化最大机器负载；此前仅增量分数版本有(1+ε)近似，且方法难扩展到删边。本文受CONGEST模型算法启发，建立新分析框架，在边删除与作业插入下维护分数解。进一步给出黑盒舍入方案，将分数算法转为整数算法，统一处理动态更新并取得近对数更新时间。这为动态负载均衡的删除与插入更新提供了统一且高效的算法框架。
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of load balancing in the dynamic setting. The input is a bipartite graph $G = (J \cup M, E)$ of jobs $J$ and machines $M$. Every job has a positive weight $w(j)$. The goal is to assign every job in $J$ to an adjacent machine in $M$ so as to minimize the maximum machine load, where the load of a machine is the sum of the weights of the jobs assigned to it.   Although load balancing has been studied extensively in many models of computation, the only previous result in the dynamic model addresses the \emph{incremental} setting, where updates take the form of edge insertions and job deletions [BKS23b]. The authors show a $(1+ε)$-approximation for incremental \emph{fractional} load balancing with $\text{poly}(\log(n),1/ε)$ update time; they point out that their techniques do not extend to the decremental setting.   Main Result: We obtain an algorithm which maintains a $(1+ε)$-approximate solution to the fractional load balancing problem under edge deletions and job insertions in $\tilde{O}(\log (n), 1/ε)$ update time. Our techniques are very different from those of the incremental algorithm of [BKS23b]. Instead, our algorithm is inspired by a load-balancing algorithm from the {\sc congest} model of computation [ALPZ21]. We develop a novel analytic framework for this algorithm, which allows us to show that it performs well in the dynamic setting.   Rounding Scheme: We also present a black-box rounding scheme for dynamic load balancing. Plugging in our fractional algorithm, we obtain a decremental algorithm for $(2+ε)$-approximate \emph{integral} load balancing with $\text{poly}(\log(n),1/ε)$ update time. We also obtain the same bounds for incremental load balancing by plugging in the fractional algorithm of [BKS23b].

papers.title_en: SARAM: Sparse Adapter Allocation with Reuse and Merging for Lifelong Robot Learning
papers.authors: SeongJun Jeong, Chungwoo Lee, Gi-Cheon Kang, Byoung-Tak Zhang
papers.evidence: 基于VLA骨干的终身机器人学习与适配器复用
papers.tldr: 终身机器人学习需要顺序获取新任务且不遗忘旧任务，基于大型VLA主干的适配器方法虽有效，但任务专属适配器与选择模块随任务流累积，导致磁盘存储与部署成本难以扩展。SARAM复用已冻结的旧任务适配器，仅在稀疏选定的层新增适配器，并用重复惩罚促使新参数捕捉适配器库尚未覆盖的信息。部署阶段用主干激活统计生成紧凑签名，每回合识别一次任务，将该任务更新合并进主干，控制回路中只保留主干。在四个LIBERO套件上，SARAM匹配或超越适配器基线，且每任务磁盘状态最多减少4.5倍。
papers.abstract_en: Lifelong robot learning requires acquiring new tasks sequentially without forgetting earlier ones. With large pre-trained vision-language-action (VLA) backbones, adapter-based methods effectively mitigate this challenge. However, their task-specific adapters and selection modules accumulate with the task stream, creating a scalability challenge in on-disk storage and deployment cost under fixed onboard resource budgets. We propose SARAM, a lifelong learning framework that limits storage growth while keeping GPU memory and per-step inference cost independent of the task stream length. For each new task, SARAM reuses frozen adapters from previous tasks and introduces new adapters only at sparsely selected layers, with a duplication penalty encouraging them to capture information not already represented by the adapter library. At deployment, a compact signature derived from backbone activation statistics identifies the task once per episode, and the corresponding task update is merged into the backbone, leaving only the backbone in the control loop. Across four LIBERO suites, SARAM matches or exceeds adapter-based baselines while adding up to 4.5x less on-disk state per task. GPU memory usage and control frequency remain comparable to those of the backbone as the task stream grows. Experiments on a real UR5 arm with a different backbone further demonstrate retention throughout a sequential task stream.

papers.title_en: CoRS: Fast Neural Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling via Composite Interval State Reuse
papers.authors: Jiang Sutong, Zhao Peng, Wu Xuan, Wang Yan, Wang Jiaqi, Zhang Rui, Jiang Yuan, Zhou You, Wang Di
papers.evidence: 基于区间状态复用的神经柔性作业车间调度
papers.tldr: 针对神经柔性作业车间调度每步刷新图表示造成推理开销大的问题，CoRS将图编码与可行性状态解耦。它让区间级图表示跨多个连续决策复用，而步级可行性状态仍逐步精确更新。方法进一步引入复合区间解码、动态约束跟踪、边界同步和增强静态特征，以保持可行调度构建并补偿表示陈旧。实验在合成及多个公开FJSP基准上显著降低推理时间，同时保持有竞争力的解质量，在紧时限与低延迟场景取得更优速度—质量权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Neural solvers for the Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling Problem (FJSP) typically refresh graph representations and update feasibility after every operation--machine decision. However, only feasibility must remain exact at every step, whereas graph encoding is substantially more expensive and can potentially be refreshed less frequently. We present CoRS, which decouples them: an interval-level graph representation is reused across multiple sequential decisions, while a stepwise feasibility state is updated after every action. This two-timescale design amortizes graph encoding without parallelizing action generation or relaxing scheduling constraints. CoRS further develops a feasibility-preserving composite-interval decoding scheme with dynamic constraint tracking and boundary state synchronization, which reduces representation refresh frequency while maintaining continuous feasible schedule construction. Furthermore, to alleviate representation staleness caused by interval-level state reuse, CoRS introduces enhanced static features as a compensation mechanism. By providing more comprehensive structural information of the scheduling problem, these features improve the model's perception of overall problem characteristics. Extensive experiments on synthetic and multiple public FJSP benchmarks demonstrate that CoRS significantly reduces inference time while maintaining competitive solution quality, achieving favorable speed-quality trade-offs under tight wall-clock budgets and low-latency scenarios.

papers.title_en: CQTwin: A Digital-Twin Toolkit for Operational Analytics of HPC Schedulers
papers.authors: Kanglin Xu, Yash Kurkure, Yihe Zhang, Michael E. Papka, Zhiling Lan
papers.evidence: 用于分析与比较HPC作业调度策略的数字孪生工具
papers.tldr: HPC设施积累多年调度记录但缺乏易用分析工具。CQTwin以离线轨迹回放和在线事件驱动仿真两种模式，将CQSim离散事件模拟器、高性能C++引擎、浏览器仪表盘与Snapshot Lab结合，支持负载刻画、策略比较和what-if探索。作者用ALCF 2016—2023生产轨迹验证其保真度。该工具帮助运维与研究人员从历史与实时调度数据中获得可行动洞察。
papers.abstract_en: HPC facilities collect years of job scheduler records, yet much of this operational data remains underused because accessible tools for turning it into actionable insight are scarce. We present CQTwin, an open-source digital-twin toolkit for operational analytics of HPC scheduling data. CQTwin addresses this gap through two complementary modes: offline trace replay and online event-driven simulation. Built on the Python-based CQSim discrete-event simulator, CQTwin combines a fidelity-validated, high-performance C++ engine with an interactive browser-based dashboard and a Snapshot Lab, enabling facility staff, operators, and researchers to characterize workloads, compare scheduling policies, and explore what-if scenarios. As an offline twin, CQTwin replays archived workload traces under alternative policies to show how the same workload would have unfolded under different scheduling decisions. As an online twin, it consumes job events as they arrive and projects how alternative policies would process the currently queued jobs, providing guidance for real-time decision-making. The dashboard supports the complete analysis workflow, including workload characterization, experiment configuration and monitoring, and multidimensional comparison of simulation results, allowing users to determine visually which policies best suit a workload and what trade-offs they entail. We validate CQTwin using production traces from the Argonne Leadership Computing Facility spanning 2016-2023.

papers.title_en: Fault-Tolerant Offloading Framework for Real-Time Applications in Mobile Edge Computing
papers.authors: Chuanchao Gao, Yiyang Gao, Michael Yuhas, Arvind Easwaran
papers.evidence: 带截止期的任务卸载与计算资源分配
papers.tldr: 面向回传网络使能的移动边缘计算，论文研究带宽与算力约束下带截止时间的任务卸载与资源分配，以最大化推理精度提升为目标。作者将其建模为整数线性规划并证明NP难，提出线性时间1/10近似算法FastSA，并设计链路与服务器故障检测恢复框架。实验显示FastSA在无故障时平均精度提升25.6%且运行时间最低，故障注入下性能退化降低12.8%。
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies a Deadline-constrained task Offloading and resource Allocation Problem (DOAP) in a backhaul-network-enabled Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) system with both bandwidth and computational resource constraints. The goal is to maximize the total inference accuracy improvement across all tasks. We formulate this problem, denoted as $\mathbf{P}$, as an Integer Linear Programming (ILP) problem and show it is NP-hard via a reduction from the maximum-weight three-dimensional matching problem. To address $\mathbf{P}$, we develop $\mathtt{FastSA}$, a linear-time $\frac{1}{10}$-approximation algorithm based on the local-ratio technique. To the best of our knowledge, $\mathtt{FastSA}$ provides the first constant-factor performance guarantee for backhaul-network-enabled DOAPs. In addition, we introduce a fault detection and recovery framework that enables robust MEC operation under backhaul link and edge server failures. Experiments using profiled image classification workloads and real-world taxi traces show that $\mathtt{FastSA}$ achieves an average accuracy improvement of $25.6\%$ over benchmark algorithms under fault-free conditions while maintaining the lowest runtime. Under fault-injected scenarios, our framework reduces performance degradation by an average of $12.8\%$, demonstrating its effectiveness in fault handling.

papers.title_en: Joint Freshness and Deadline Feasibility in Store-and-Forward Satellite IoT Networks
papers.evidence: 存储转发卫星物联网中的截止期限与新鲜度调度
papers.tldr: 针对3GPP R19存储转发卫星物联网中馈线中断积压与有限可见窗口的矛盾，本文把状态更新的目的地新鲜度和事件报告的截止期约束统一建模为周期性两跳接触下的QoS可行性问题。对一般接触日历，推导顺序敏感的漏报、队列容量、投递率与新鲜度界，并给出仅状态流的精确刻画；对单状态流与单事件类共享接触对，构造有限状态规划获得任意整数年龄阈值下的精确联合可行性。数值结果量化了负载、容量、截止期与新鲜度容忍度之间的权衡，为静态优先级之外的调度设计提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: 3GPP Release 19 supports store-and-forward satel- lite access, where traffic accumulated during feeder-link outages must be forwarded through finite, geometry-limited windows. Static priority levels offer little discrimination among large backlogs and ignore the decay in packet value. We formulate QoS feasibility for status updates, measured by destination freshness, and deadline-constrained event reports over periodic two-hop contacts with finite onboard storage. For general calendars, we derive ordering-sensitive miss, cohort-capacity, delivery-rate, and freshness bounds, including an exact status-only characterization. For single status flow and single event class sharing a contact pair per period, a finite-state program gives exact joint feasibility for arbitrary integer age thresholds. Numerical results quantify tradeoffs among load, capacity, deadline, and freshness tolerance.

papers.title_en: Tight Bounds for Paging with Time Windows and Joint Replenishment with Varying Opening Costs
papers.evidence: 带时间窗的在线调度算法与竞争比界
papers.tldr: 加权带时间窗分页长期落后于无权情形，此前最优竞争比仅为O(log k log n)，加权与无权之间仍存明显差距。本文提出结构分解，将缓存配置的演化与页面加载调度分离，从而分别处理延迟服务和批处理请求。给定缓存配置序列后，计算近优页面加载序列可归约为带截止期和时变开启成本的JRP-D变体；作者设计常数竞争在线算法并证明该归约是紧的。结合已有缓存配置在线构造，最终得到O(log k)竞争算法，匹配无权情形的最优界，并缩小加权分页的长期差距。
papers.abstract_en: We study the paging with time windows problem, a natural generalization of classical paging, in which each request must be served within a specified time interval. This model allows the algorithm to delay service and batch service requests over time, but also introduces significant challenges due to overlapping requests. While the problem is well understood in the unweighted setting, where optimal $O(\log k)$-competitive algorithms are known, the weighted case remains more elusive. The best previously known algorithm, due to Gupta, Kumar, and Panigrahi, achieves an $O(\log k \log n)$-competitive ratio, leaving a gap between weighted and unweighted settings.   We obtain an $O(\log k)$-competitive algorithm for weighted paging with time windows, matching the optimal competitive ratio. The core of our approach is a structural decomposition that separates the evolution of the cache from the scheduling of page loads. We show that, given a sequence of cache configurations, computing a near-optimal sequence of page loads reduces to a variant of the Joint Replenishment Problem with deadlines (JRP-D) with time-dependent opening costs. We design a constant-competitive online algorithm for this variant and prove that the reduction is tight. Combining this with an existing online construction of cache configurations yields the desired bound.

papers.title_en: Adaptive Deadline- and Energy-Aware Caching Algorithms in Dynamic Multi-UAV Edge Networks
papers.evidence: 多无人机边缘网络中考虑截止期与能耗的缓存放置与替换
papers.tldr: 针对地面设施不可用时多无人机边缘缓存中时变异构需求、内容截止期与通信能耗不均问题，论文构建联合截止期错过、无人机通信能耗及机间能耗失衡的动态缓存放置与替换模型。先提出可解释的分层规则方法DE-UBAC，再提出结合局部/全局GRU时序表征与集中式PPO的GRU-DEPPO进行自适应决策。仿真中GRU-DEPPO取得最低截止期错过率和无人机侧通信总能耗，较DE-UBAC将截止期错过率降低约61%、机间能耗失衡降低约40%。
papers.abstract_en: Content caching via unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) becomes one of the solutions to maintain content delivery when terrestrial infrastructure is unavailable or disrupted. However, existing caching approaches often focus primarily on cache-hit performance or average delivery delay, without jointly addressing spatially heterogeneous and time-varying demand, content-specific deadlines, and uneven communication-energy consumption across UAVs. To address these challenges, we formulate a dynamic deadline- and energy-aware cache placement and replacement problem that jointly considers deadline misses, UAV-side communication energy, and inter-UAV energy imbalance. To achieve this, we first develop deadline- and energy-aware UBAC (DE-UBAC), an interpretable hierarchical rule-based realization that incorporates deadline-aware prioritization, cooperative placement, energy-aware coordination, and cache-update cost. However, predefined priorities and thresholds limit its adaptability under dynamically coupled network conditions. We therefore propose GRU-assisted Deadline- and Energy-aware Proximal Policy Optimization (GRU-DEPPO), which combines local and global GRU-based temporal representations with a centralized PPO actor-critic for adaptive cache placement and replacement. Simulation results show that GRU-DEPPO achieves the lowest deadline-miss rate and total UAV-side communication energy among the considered schemes. Compared with DE-UBAC, GRU-DEPPO reduces the deadline-miss rate by approximately 61% and inter-UAV energy imbalance by approximately 40%.
